note: Supplementary behavioural log. The screen recording is the primary record. All measures are behavioural proxies; no gaze or attention is measured.

definitions.ms: Milliseconds from the attempt’s t0 (first frame showing Home after Start). Negative = before t0.
definitions.t0: Timestamp of the first animation frame that draws Home after the Start tap.
definitions.tap: Pointer down and up with at most 10 px movement; time = pointer down. role "dead" = non-interactive area.
definitions.relevant: Tap on the task’s valid-first-step list (src/data/relevantTaps.js).
definitions.timeMs: Completed: end time − t0 (T1/T2: Add to cart pointer down; T3: first Order confirmed frame). Time limit: exactly 120000 or 180000.
definitions.firstRelevantTapStatus: observed | censored_time_limit (no relevant tap before the limit; value = the limit) | none_before_end | not_applicable (abandoned/interrupted).
definitions.measuresWindow: Measures use events with 0 <= ms <= end time and afterEnd false.
definitions.item_visibility: IntersectionObserver within the screen’s scroll area; level "any" (>0 % visible) or "full" (100 %). Cards under the added-to-cart panel still count as visible.
definitions.scroll: scrollTop of the screen’s scroll area, at most every 100 ms while moving, plus a final sample 150 ms after it stops.
definitions.notComputed: Wrong turns, taps against the shortest path and scroll-pasts are not computed (rules not yet decided); the raw events are included.
